name: async-test-mocking-pattern
description: For trader.py async functions that call db.* and get_market_metadata, patch at the module level (core.trader.db.X) using AsyncMock. With asyncio_mode=auto in pytest.ini, plain async def test_* functions run automatically without @pytest.mark.asyncio. Use _make_signal/_make_trade/_make_market factory helpers to produce valid Pydantic models in one call.

content: pytest.ini must be saved without UTF-8 BOM on Windows; strip with open(rb)/decode(utf-8-sig)/write(utf-8) if editors add it

test_settings_defaults must call monkeypatch.delenv for all settings-related env vars (POLYMARKET_*, MIN_*, MAX_*, CONSENSUS_*, DISCORD_*, LOG_LEVEL, etc.) before instantiating Settings(). The shell environment on this machine exports all .env.example vars, so any test checking Settings() defaults without clearing env vars will fail.
